blocks.text: TARLAC CITY, Philippines — Ambassadors and accredited diplomats from various countries joined a tour of this year’s Belenismo sa Tarlac on Saturday night, Nov. 21. Among the visitors were the following: The annual festival, organized by Tarlac Heritage of Tarlac and led by co-founders Dr. Isa Cojuangco Suntay and her daughter, Doña Isabel Cojuangco Suntay, runs from Nov. 4 to Jan. 6, 2027.
